title: Made an AI assisted game. If there is any overlap between this sub, wsb and degenerate option trading let me know if the game's fun.
author: CyberInu4200
selftext:
Give it a go if you were curious about modern day highly leveraged option trading. You will learn nothing, you will probably lose virtual money. The demo is f2p and feedback's welcome. Antis welcome to hate on it, because it boosts the algo. Screen is what usually happens if you get greedy. Anyway markets are closed so you might as well.

All companies are randomly generated each run. So Orbital Quantum Chicken Industries is something that can happen. Atm 2 hidden Easter Eggs, demo limited to 1 in-game year of gameplay. The professions have a bunch of routes that last about 10 in-game years.

You can roast everything else so long as it's constructive.

Free itch demo is here: [https://cyberinu4200.itch.io/daily-bagholder](https://cyberinu4200.itch.io/daily-bagholder)
